ctbids-49067-5800531.description:
An elegant, authentic vintage bead station necklace from Rio Pearl (Rio Pearl, Hong Kong), a maker highly regarded for fine cultured pearl and gemstone jewelry collections. Hallmarked 750. Weighs 6 grams, and is a 16” necklace when latched.
This classic piece features smooth, vibrant green round gemstone beads arranged evenly along a delicate, highly reflective 18-karat white gold 16” station link chain. The necklace is designed with an extension loop chain and a secure lobster-claw closure, tipped with a final green bead charm for a beautiful finish down the back of the neck. It comes presented in its original, vibrant green textile fold-up jewelry wallet featuring the stamped golden "Rio Pearl" emblem inside.
Condition: Like new, vintage condition. The 18K white gold chain links are intact, the clasp operates smoothly with strong spring tension, and the stones display an even, glossy polish. Original textile presentation wallet included as shown.

283023390.description:
Vintage Hemingray-42 Aqua Glass Telephone Pole Insulator w/ Iron Peg
Vintage Hemingray glass telegraph/telephone pole insulator in aqua/teal blue color. Features embossed 'HEMINGRAY-42' lettering and beaded skirt design around the base. Includes original wrought iron pole mounting peg/pin with wood-covered threaded shaft, used to attach the insulator to utility poles. Both pieces show age-appropriate wear consistent with antique railroad/telegraph line hardware, including surface rust on the iron peg and natural glass wear with embedded dirt. Authentic antique collectible pairing a Hemingray glass insulator with its matching iron pin. Popular among insulator and telegraphiana collectors.
10 x 4 x 4 in
